subject.title: feat: Control UI debug mode — ephemeral connection logs and error details

question: What exact pre-auth Control UI diagnostic contents may be displayed and copied by users before the Gateway connection is authenticated?
rationale: The feature is useful, but the safe boundary depends on maintainer intent for redaction, retention, and whether handshake/auth/device details may be surfaced before auth succeeds.

options.title: Sanitized client-side transcript
options.body: Expose lifecycle phases, sanitized detail codes, close codes/reasons, and recovery hints in memory only, while excluding raw frames, credentials, signatures, nonces, and unredacted endpoint secrets.

options.title: Authenticated diagnostics only
options.body: Keep the disconnected gate limited to recovery guidance and add richer logs only after an authenticated connection can authorize `logs.tail` or equivalent diagnostics.

options.title: Do not add a debug mode
options.body: Keep the current categorized login errors and require support/debugging through CLI logs or server-side diagnostics.

recommendation.title: Sanitized client-side transcript
recommendation.body: Expose lifecycle phases, sanitized detail codes, close codes/reasons, and recovery hints in memory only, while excluding raw frames, credentials, signatures, nonces, and unredacted endpoint secrets.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest recent history on the current Control UI gateway/login/debug files and is already subscribed to this issue.
